mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 280 indicates persistent inflation, which typically triggers monetary policy tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 280.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the CPIAUCSL exceeds 280, it indicates a high-inflation, low-rate environment that often leads to market volatility and negative equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 280.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong economic growth and corporate earnings, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1700 indicates weak housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production (INDPRO) level above 100 (the 2017 base) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A residential fixed investment (RSAFS) level above 600,000 indicates strong housing market demand and economic expansion, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 600,000.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 4.5% indicates a tightening labor market and potential for monetary policy tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.5%.
